# Speech test fixture

`librispeech-1089-134686.flac` (≈21 s, 16 kHz mono) is utterances `1089-134686-0000` and
`1089-134686-0002` from **LibriSpeech test-clean**, joined by 4 s of silence (to exercise VAD).

- Source: LibriSpeech ASR corpus, Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey, Sanjeev Khudanpur,
  https://www.openslr.org/12
- License: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Modification: concatenation with inserted silence, re-encoded as FLAC.
